app.title: KysoQR
app.promo: Secure digital signing for your documents

home.title: Sign a contract in one drag-and-drop.
home.subtitle: KysoQR is a QR-based digital document signing service: upload a PDF, approve the signing request in the Cas ID app, and get back a validly signed PDF anyone can verify by its signing code or by uploading the file.

upload.title: Upload your PDF
upload.description: Up to 20 MB. Files are held temporarily and deleted after 24 hours.

place.title: Place your signature, then confirm in the Cas ID app
place.description: Scan the QR code or receive a push notification in the Cas ID app to approve the signing request — a PAdES digital signature with a timestamp from a licensed CA.

download.title: Get back a validly signed PDF
download.description: Anyone can verify it anytime using the signing code printed on the file, or by uploading the PDF itself.

signCard.title: Sign or verify a signature now, no login needed
signCard.dropzoneSubtitle: or choose a file from your device to start signing

recentSignatures.title: 5 most recent signatures
recentSignatures.downloadError: Couldn't download this file (the download allowance may be used up). Please use a copy you already downloaded.

steps.helperUploadRequest: Start by uploading your PDF and preparing the signing request.
steps.helperScan: Ask the signer to scan the QR code with their Cas ID app and approve the signing request.
steps.helperDone: Open or download the signed PDF and keep it with your records.

signerConfig.cccdHint: Required to send a signing request to the Cas ID app. 12 digits (or 9 for an old CMND). Leave blank for QR-only signing.

signerConfig.noCccdWarning: Without a citizen ID we can only offer QR signing — no notification will be pushed to the Cas ID app.

errors.cccd: Citizen ID must be 12 digits (or 9 for an old CMND).
errors.taxCode: Tax code must be 10 digits, optionally followed by -3 digits.
errors.organizationName: Company name is required for enterprise signers.

permission.description: We will generate a QR code for the signer to approve this signing request in the Cas ID app.

downloadReminder.title: Your document is signed
downloadReminder.body: Download it now to keep a copy on your device — the file stays here, but it's easy to lose track of this page later.

verdict.validNote: The signing round completed, the certificate is valid, and the document hasn't changed since it was signed.
verdict.invalidTitle: The document was changed after signing
verdict.invalidNote: The signature was valid when signed, but the document's current content no longer matches the signed version. Don't rely on this copy as evidence.
